Vendored unmodified docs/binjgb.js and docs/binjgb.wasm
Source revision: 16621111ed0ee73bcc45c912a823bcebedcffc0f

The emulator executes the original ROM with CGB support and MBC5 battery RAM.
No CPU, timing, mapper, RNG, collision or save format modifications were made.
Emulator source can be obtained at the URL and revision above; MIT does not require bundling source.
Application UI, integration, renderer and tests were written for this milestone.
